topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: Limited onboard memory directly impacts power allocation by prioritizing time-tagged services over less urgent ones, leading to increased latency. This tradeoff necessitates adaptive power management algorithms that dynamically adjust transmit power based on channel conditions and packet arrival patterns. Advanced modulation formats like QAM or OFDM can help mitigate this impact by improving spectral efficiency.
